source.meaning: Frozen source for adapter fixtures only; this pin is not a release or balance verdict.

scope.game: original solo four-seat finite extensive-form game
scope.termination: Original playPolicyGame termination and settlement order; not fully adapted by this fixture batch.
scope.ordinaryChains: All six ordinary chains remain in scope for the eventual solver.

secureDraw.exactJointProbability: 1/1296, conditional on independent uniform secure bytes

destiny.privacy: Each seat sees its own private letter; opponents remain hidden until the actual public reveal. This is a local UI/data projection, not server-grade secrecy.

scope.root: All legal makeState initializations and exact chance support remain required; this fixture batch only checks the private destiny draw component.
scope.quantification: All legal reachable histories, each player's legal observation-equivalent information sets, every legal contingent policy and every positive-probability chance outcome through original terminal settlement.
exclusions: fixed AI or scriptedBids profiles as a substitute for player action sets
random seeds or sampled outcomes as a substitute for complete chance support
one-night state snapshots as a substitute for complete cross-night restore
public replay projection as a substitute for a generic all-seat observation adapter
single-machine UI privacy as server-grade secrecy

fixtures.proves: The exact committed index.html source, Git blob and SHA256 are pinned; the worktree product file matches that source.
fixtures.doesNotProve: The pinned product is balanced, release-ready, or exhaustively modeled.

fixtures.proves: The engine maps each of 252 accepted byte values to six IDs with 42 preimages each, rejects 252 through 255, and can produce all 1296 four-seat tuples with collisions.
fixtures.doesNotProve: Complete chance support or exact probabilities for initialization, auctions, battles, events, or any other game RNG node.

fixtures.proves: A graph-preserving state-only snapshot at makeState-to-first-resolveAuction replays the same auction, preserves aliases and restores the next gameplay RNG output.
fixtures.doesNotProve: Runner-local variables, arbitrary decision boundaries, cross-night continuation, or a complete extensive-form state adapter.

fixtures.proves: Different hidden bid profiles produce the same public replay until the relevant auction result is explicitly revealed.
fixtures.doesNotProve: A complete legal action enumerator, hidden-commitment transition API, or observation history for all seats.

fixtures.proves: A seat's destiny projection is unchanged by opponent private draws and an opponent letter appears only after publishDestinyReveal.
fixtures.doesNotProve: Generic information-set keys, full recall, or observation equivalence for every game decision.

inventory.blockingReason: No complete legal initialization enumerator with exact correlated shuffle/draw weights.
Fixture covers only engine-resident state and RNG at the initial auction boundary; runner-local state is not captured.
Arbitrary phase and runner-local cross-night state restore are not adapted.
No all-seat legal decision cursor or commit/advance API.
No exhaustive legal bid, target, type, intent, cap, or stake action enumeration.
Event, mark, incense, shrine-pick, and other live human choices are not enumerated.
Public replay privacy is fixture-tested; a generic simultaneous sealed commitment adapter is absent.
Destiny projection is fixture-tested; all-seat observation histories and information-set keys are absent.
The four private destiny draws are exhaustively fixture-tested; every other game chance node remains uncovered.
No complete discrete chance support and exact conditional weights for the original game.
No proven strategic/probabilistic equivalence key for state merging.
Original terminal value, rank ties, and freeLunch net-gain baseline are not completely mapped.
No complete contingent policy enumeration over all legal information sets.
No exhaustive cross-night result or independent solver review.

nextEngineeringDeliverable.name: all-seat legal action and observation adapter
requirements: Expose every legal action at each original human decision without changing settlement order.
Keep simultaneous sealed bids hidden until the original reveal point.
Derive observation histories without opponent hidden bags, unrevealed bids, future market, or RNG state.
Bind each adapter fixture to the frozen product source and compare it with the original engine.

gate.blockingReason: Full-game actions, observations, chance, cross-night restore, canonicalization, policy enumeration, terminal/payoff mapping, and independent review remain incomplete. H9 failures and incomplete groups remain separate gates.
